instruction: 외부 Android 게임을 black-box로 검증할 때 실행, 실제 게임 진입, 입력 반응, 프로세스 생존, 크래시 부재를 단계별 증거로 결속해 판정하고 코드·에셋·내부 알고리즘은 추출하거나 추론하지 않는다.
output:
검증된 관찰 원칙:
- 프로세스 실행과 실제 게임 진입을 같은 것으로 취급하지 않는다.
- 입력 주입만으로 성공 처리하지 않고 입력 전후의 의미 있는 화면 변화와 대상 프로세스 생존을 함께 확인한다.
- 시스템 오버레이·동의 화면·게임 진입·입력 반응을 서로 다른 증거 단계로 보존한다.
- 성공 범위는 캡처된 검증 구간으로 제한하고 장시간 안정성이나 숨은 규칙을 추정하지 않는다.
- 부분 성공 뒤 실패가 생기면 성공 경계와 실패 경계를 모두 기록한다.
- 외부 게임의 소스 코드, 에셋, 고유 UI 표현, 내부 알고리즘, 숨은 점수·경제 규칙은 black-box 학습 데이터로 추출하거나 복제하지 않는다.
검증된 게임별 적용 원리:
- APPLY: id=gameplay-state-must-be-visually-distinct-from-selection-state; scope=mobile-runtime-evidence; lesson=A mobile title or game-selection screen is not equivalent to gameplay entry; the first verified playable state should expose the game-specific interaction surface and controls together.; apply=For Roblox mobile verification, define GAME_ENTRY using visible gameplay-specific state rather than process launch or menu completion alone.
- APPLY: id=persistent-contextual-action-controls; scope=mobile-interaction-observation; lesson=The verified puzzle state keeps the numeric action controls visible beside the active play surface so the next valid interaction is immediately available without reopening a separate menu.; apply=When appropriate for a Roblox mobile interaction, keep the small set of context-relevant actions directly available near the active gameplay state instead of adding unnecessary navigation layers.
- APPLY: id=immediate-spatially-anchored-input-feedback; scope=mobile-feedback-observation; lesson=The exercised input produces an immediate visible value change in the affected board cell, making the result of the touch easy to associate with the selected target.; apply=For Roblox mobile controls, prefer visible feedback at or near the affected gameplay object so the user can confirm that the touch produced the intended state change.
- APPLY: id=before-after-plus-runtime-survival-evidence; scope=qa-evidence; lesson=A mobile input becomes strong black-box evidence when the same gameplay state is captured immediately before and after the input and the target process remains foreground and crash-free.; apply=Bind mobile interaction evidence to semantic before/after frames plus process, focus, fatal-crash and ANR checks; never promote screen-hash change alone.
검증된 학습 활용 범위:
- ALLOWED: mobile gameplay-entry boundary detection
- ALLOWED: contextual mobile action availability
- ALLOWED: spatially anchored input feedback
- ALLOWED: input-to-visible-state evidence binding
- ALLOWED: foreground/process/crash correlation
- ALLOWED: portable mobile interaction lessons that may inform later Roblox-specific implementation and verification
검증된 학습 금지 범위:
- FORBIDDEN: treating Android evidence as Roblox runtime evidence
- FORBIDDEN: inferring hidden puzzle-solving algorithms or correctness logic from the captured run
- FORBIDDEN: copying SGTPuzzles artwork, UI trade dress, puzzle content, names or implementation details into a Roblox game
- FORBIDDEN: claims about long-run stability or behavior not measured by the captured validation window
